title: Triumph: Life on the Other Side of Trials, Transplants, Transition and Transformation
author: Derrick T. Wells
target_audience: Individuals facing personal or health challenges
Readers seeking motivation and faith-based inspiration
Those interested in stories of resilience and transformation
core_themes: Living with chronic illness and recovery
The power of community and support
primary_purpose: To inspire and encourage readers by sharing a personal journey through extreme physical and emotional challenges, demonstrating the possibility of hope, faith, and renewal on the other side of hardship.

structure_format.organization: Chronological storytelling interwoven with thematic reflections on pivotal life moments
features: Practical lessons applicable to readers’ own struggles

key_concepts_lessons: No matter the depth of adversity, hope and transformation are possible.
Faith and spirituality can provide strength in the darkest times.
Physical and emotional challenges can lead to personal growth.
Community and support networks are vital for overcoming trials.
Transition and recovery are ongoing processes, not end points.
Sharing one’s story can empower others on their journeys.
notable_features: Rare firsthand account of organ transplantation and recovery
Integration of spiritual insight alongside medical narrative
Focus on practical hope and encouragement
Accessible for general audiences and faith-based readers
cultural_historical_context: Published in the early 2020s, a period of increased public attention to organ donation, chronic illness, and mental health. The book reflects broader cultural conversations about resilience, faith, and navigating significant life transitions.
reception_impact: Appreciated in transplant, patient advocacy, and faith communities
Recognized for its authenticity and honest portrayal of pain and hope
Used as an inspirational resource in support groups and ministries
comparable_titles: Option B: Facing Adversity, Building Resilience, and Finding Joy by Sheryl Sandberg and Adam Grant
When Breath Becomes Air by Paul Kalanithi
Proof of Heaven by Eben Alexander
Between Life and Death: A Gospel-Centered Guide to End-of-Life Medical Care by Kathryn Butler
